summary: Clemens-Wither提供指向明显负效应的高质量准实验:以2007-2009联邦上调(约+30%)为冲击,受约束州的target低技能工人就业与收入增长显著受损,全国就业-人口比降约0.7个百分点(对target群体隐含弹性近-1)。但情境是大衰退+高bindingness,外推到常态温和上调需谨慎。

evidence.title: Clemens-Wither:target群体明显受损
evidence.quote: binding minimum wage increases had significant, negative effects on the employment and income growth of targeted workers

evidence.title: Clemens-Wither:就业-人口比降0.7pp
evidence.quote: minimum wage increases reduced the national employment-to-population ratio by 0.7 percentage point

open_questions: 衰退期的负效应有多少可外推到经济扩张期的城市上调?
